gaps.explanation: JSON disbursements 6,917,963.11 = p10 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds) Less: Cost of purchased power 3,238,510.49 + Total operating expenses 3,617,358.03 + Interest expense 62,094.59. Detail holds only four one-line fund totals from the p14 all-funds Budgetary Basis schedule: detail 158 Electric 4,325,550.21, 159 Waste 581,691.60, 160 Wastewater 747,126.02, 161 Water 538,136.97 = 6,192,504.80. Business-type revenue (above) is taken from the same p10 fund columns, so, as in the Gothenburg_FY2025 fix, the p10 expense rows are added per fund column (Total column not used): Electric Less: Cost of purchased power 3,238,510.49 + 14 operating rows 1,573,105.27 (3,780.56 + 32,251.78 + 680,685.98 + 42,111.32 + 141,281.64 + 519.06 + 4,226.07 + 349,035.16 + 17,610.90 + 13,097.14 + 1,150.00 + 21,574.60 + 252,536.83 + 13,244.23 = printed Total operating expenses) + Interest expense 30,046.05 = 4,841,661.81; Water 13 operating rows 591,202.43 (188.05 + 10,414.44 + 241,454.76 + 42,249.12 + 8,990.61 + 286.40 + 912.30 + 70,418.05 + 64,396.18 + 10,548.26 + 2,187.50 + 119,373.89 + 19,782.87; printed total 591,202.43) + Interest expense 12,831.67 = 604,034.10; Sewer 13 operating rows 871,358.73 (1,937.20 + 3,405.04 + 442,222.50 + 42,310.49 + 43,933.54 + 250.00 + 1,174.88 + 75,760.46 + 78,129.09 + 13,018.17 + 25,872.01 + 140,073.42 + 3,271.93; printed total 871,358.73) + Interest expense 19,216.87 = 890,575.60; Waste 5 rows 162.00 + 570,328.65 + 8,814.12 + 571.84 + 1,814.99 = 581,691.60. Sum 6,917,963.11. Each p14 line is the same fund's spending as the added p10 rows of that fund (budgetary basis instead of accrual), so all four are removed: detail 158 Electric 4,325,550.21 -> held by the added Electric rows (4,841,661.81); detail 159 Waste 581,691.60 -> held by the added Waste rows (581,691.60, equal); detail 160 Wastewater 747,126.02 -> held by the added Sewer rows (890,575.60; p14 'Wastewater' = p10 'Sewer'); detail 161 Water 538,136.97 -> held by the added Water rows (604,034.10). The per-fund differences (Electric 516,111.60, Sewer 143,449.58, Water 65,897.13) are the printed budgetary vs accrual basis difference (p10 includes depreciation), not lost money. Gain (Loss) on sale of fixed assets (4,548.75) / (7,980.27) (p10) and transfers out (p11) stay as the pass-2 other-financing lines. Check: 6,192,504.80 - 6,192,504.80 + 6,917,963.11 = 6,917,963.11 = statement.
